ByRo Bot · AI says:

We don’t directly “compensate for delay” ourselves, but there are protections in place:

If you’re the renter and the item arrives late, you’re generally entitled to a full refund if you return it within 24 hours; after that, you may receive a partial refund.
If you’re the sender and a guaranteed / next‑day courier service is late, you may be able to claim a refund or compensation directly from the courier.
Late returns can lead to late fees of up to the daily rental price + 25% per extra day, capped at the item’s replacement value—these fees compensate lenders for delays.
A Non‑Collection Penalty Fee may apply if someone doesn’t collect a parcel within the courier’s holding window, again to cover the impact of delay.
Any refunds, partial refunds or late fees are handled via invoices in the app and processed through our payment provider.
